sources.title: Edition-specific commercial survival comparison against the bounded local service
sources.author: Causal banking research project
sources.version_date: 2026-10-16;author matrix and actual local method-dispatch probes
supported_claims: Current local request enum and dispatcher expose no named survival operation;three authored survival profiles return unsupported.
Nine vendor-family rows distinguish documented strengths,limits,proposed comparison,current gap,rights and unknown prices.
Coverage remains inconclusive;MATLAB and exact editions/rights stay unresolved.
limitations: Bounded author comparison, not a market census, installed vendor trial, purchase recommendation or independent acceptance.
Commercial findings are limited to the inspected official source records and their declared edition/date/rights limits.
Current capability is an actual local reference-service observation; no vendor runtime or upstream package execution occurred.
Prices, entitlements, embedding/redistribution rights and deployment performance remain unavailable unless explicitly recorded.
Dynamic-regime identification, survival fitting and competing-risk estimation remain outside the current operation enum.
Public/generated acceptance cases are proposed next work; authentic bank truth and owner inputs remain later requirements.
